name: César Barreto
detail: Former Minister of Finance; stated that an emergency wealth tax is "el peor impuesto", complex to audit, and causes capital flight.

name: Óscar Orué
detail: Viceministro de Tributación (SET / DNIT); rejected wealth tax proposals arguing unconstitutionality, double taxation and lack of economic feasibility.

name: Basilio Núñez
detail: Diputado / Senador (ANR - Honor Colorado); led rejection of wealth tax in Diputados arguing it penalises job creators and duplicates existing taxes.

name: Tadeo Rojas
detail: Diputado (ANR - Honor Colorado); rejected wealth tax in Diputados as unconstitutional and warned it would frighten foreign investment.

name: Celso Kennedy
detail: Diputado (PLRA - Caaguazú); voted against wealth tax stating it would be harmful and not the right time for taxing large wealth.

name: Édgar Acosta
detail: Diputado (PLRA - Central); voted to archive wealth tax bill stating that while debate on large wealth is valid, the proposal was not appropriate.

name: FEPRINCO
detail: Federación de la Producción, la Industria y el Comercio; primary business confederation of Paraguay, emphatically rejected wealth taxes and tax increases.

name: Juana Larrea
detail: Leader of OTEP-SN; presented the educational emergency bill, but her quoted statement focused solely on educational infrastructure and biosecurity without mentioning the wealth tax.

name: Víctor Pavón
detail: Economist and law dean who strongly rejected the wealth tax, describing the proposed impuesto al patrimonio as 'nefasta, dañina y antipatriota' and arguing it would deter investment and cause capital flight.

name: Silvio Ovelar
detail: Senator (ANR) and President of the Senate Hacienda and Budget Committee who recommended rejection of the 2020 Tasa Covid wealth tax bill and voted against it in the 5 May 2020 roll call.

name: Stephan Rasmussen
detail: Senator (Patria Querida) and President of the Senate Cuentas y Control Committee who recommended rejection of the 2020 Tasa Covid wealth tax bill and voted against it in the 5 May 2020 roll call.

name: Mario Abdo Benítez
detail: President of Paraguay (2018–2023) who publicly rejected the wealth tax proposal as 'inoportuna', 'ilógica' and 'poco inteligente'.

name: UIP - Unión Industrial Paraguaya
detail: Major national industrial confederation that rejected wealth tax and Tasa Covid proposals as 'desatinadas'.

name: Juan Carlos Galaverna
detail: Senator (ANR) who spoke against the Tasa Covid wealth tax in the Senate plenary and opposed the proposal.

name: Fidel Zavala
detail: Senator (Patria Querida) who rejected wealth tax proposals in plenary debate and voted against the Tasa Covid bill on 5 May 2020.

name: Enrique Bacchetta
detail: Senator (ANR) who spoke against emergency tax proposals in plenary and voted against the Tasa Covid wealth tax bill on 5 May 2020.
